audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits 53.29% over 167 games: Brand's Sear cancels the channel Aurelion Sol farms and trades with, and Cosmic Creator's permanent Stardust is what takes the lane back late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 5 read 'Skill' on the full layer against 'Brand' in the content layer and the packet, and row 6 read 'Aurelion Sol' on the full layer against 'Brand' in the content layer.
audit.why: Brand holds rows 0-5: Breath of Light is a channel any CC cancels, Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1, and Falling Star telegraphs its impact — all countable, all answerable with a 1050-range Sear. Row 6 goes to Aurelion Sol because Cosmic Creator makes every Stardust stack permanent and Singularity executes below a health threshold at its centre, which no amount of Brand poke undoes.
audit.corrected: Full phases[3..5].side -> Brand (rating on row 3 raised to match rows 0-2); row 6 stays Aurelion Sol on the full layer and content win[6] moves Brand -> Aurelion Sol with whys[6] rewritten. One atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names a single real Aurelion Sol ability (packet defect) and instead repeatedly uses the pre-rework kit: 'Starsurge', 'star orbit', 'star size', 'Comet of Legend'. None of those exist. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit in it.
audit.why: The real kit is Cosmic Creator (P, permanent Stardust), Breath of Light (Q, 3s, 750, a channel), Astral Flight (W, 22s at rank 1, 1500, also a channel), Singularity (E, 12s, 750, percent-health with an execute at its centre) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100, stun). Three decisive interactions were absent: Sear cancels his Q and W channels outright; Singularity's execute means the HP number matters, not the bar; and stacking MR does not answer percent-health damage.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one across whys, spikes, early/mid/late and wants; channel-cancel, execute threshold and percent-health written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad verbatim) plus the digit-free cooldowns field.
audit.why: Both titles promised ablaze discipline and rotation discipline; the bodies repeated trade text.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Conflagration's point-and-click ablaze and Singularity's execute respectively. The packet suspectName 'Your Pillar of Flame' is a FALSE POSITIVE and was left alone.

audit.why: No patch-dated claim in the text for 26.15. The obsolete ability names are a rework artefact, not a patch-sensitivity issue.
